rationale: Source is feature-shaped ('Crear un agente', 'Incorporar', 'aprovechar la capacidad') with rich named entities: PandasAgent, A2UI outputs/dashboards, QuerySource, DatasourceManager, InfographicToolkit, WorkingMemoryToolkit, skills (/widget, /infographic), kb documents, deterministic HTML refresh. Wiki unavailable (CLI+MCP timeout) — grep-first plan. Goal: locate every named building block and one or more existing PandasAgent-based dashboard agents to use as the pattern to extend.

Locate WorkingMemoryToolkit and its agent wiring.
